# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for any non-numeric characters in 'revenue' (e.g., $, commas, etc.)
# We'll check if all values are valid decimal strings
import re

# Pattern to match valid decimal numbers (e.g., '185.30')
valid_pattern = re.compile(r'^\d+\.\d{2}$')

# Check if all revenue values match the pattern
all_valid = df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: bool(valid_pattern.match(str(x))))

# Count how many are invalid
invalid_count = (~all_valid).sum()
